scope: RGBA artwork review board for the palm light revision.

assets.prompt: Precise local edit of this Đại Lực Kim Cương Chưởng transparent pixel-art comparison. Keep the two-row composition, the two unchanged saffron monks, all four open golden palm silhouettes and their exact positions and sizes. Upper row stays three equal small palms in three stepped lanes, with the upper palm farthest right, middle halfway, lower closest. Lower row stays one much larger golden palm. Change ONLY the light around the projectile silhouettes: completely erase all existing long horizontal gold streaks and restore full transparency in the gap from the monk to each hand. Give each palm a thin luminous amber and ivory aura hugging the contours of fingers, thumb and wrist, plus a small drifting amber glow immediately behind the wrist on the left. The entire rear glow fades to transparent within 20–30 percent of that particular palm's width, like a soft flicker and two or three local sparks, never a streak, beam, speed line, or ribbon. The edges remain pixel-finished and the thumb, fingers and palm lines clearly readable. Most of the canvas between projectiles is completely empty alpha. No added objects, no text, no black backdrop, no red or green fringe.
